description: PyTomography's SPECT cameras: each one's energy resolution model (FWHM against energy) and intrinsic spatial resolution (FWHM at 140 keV). The only energy resolution model so far is Morphis et al.'s, FWHM = a + b sqrt(E + c E^2), E and FWHM in keV.

cameras.name: Siemens Symbia T

energy_resolution.source: Morphis et al., Heliyon 7:e06097 (2021), https://doi.org/10.1016/j.heliyon.2021.e06097: the fit for a Siemens Symbia T16 (SIMIND's siemens.erf)

cameras.intrinsic_source: Siemens Radbook (2017): intrinsic spatial resolution FWHM at most 3.8 mm in the central field of view
